# Nudo

> Welcome back to JavaScript. Nudo executes your JS on Abs (`shape × term × pred × conf`) so you can observe intermediates and gate contracts sharper than declared types. Your JS stays JS.

Nudo docs are dual-locale (en + zh-Hans). Product face: Day0 `nudo check` · Day1 `nudo contract` + `check` · ecosystem `nudo export`. `nudo test` is optional debug case reporting. Contracts are `*.nudo.js` / `@nudo:contract`. `@nudo:case` is debug-only. Entry unconstrained params display as `any`; `unknown` means inference failed.

## Docs (HTML)

Base: https://nudojs.github.io/nudo

### Getting started

- [Introduction](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/intro): Nudo lets developers see variables close to runtime inside the source — per-variable precise derivations, not broad type names; contracts sharper than types; logic stays JavaScript.
- [Why Nudo](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/why-nudo): Why Nudo — per-variable precise derivations for code understanding; contracts sharper than type systems for robustness; logic and contracts stay JavaScript with no second type language.
- [Installation](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/getting-started/installation): Install the Nudo CLI, VS Code extension, and Vite plugin via npm, pnpm, or yarn — published packages require Node.js >= 20.
- [Mental model](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/getting-started/mental-model): Nudo mental model — execute JS on abstract values, see runtime-adjacent variables in source; observation and contracts; call sites are evidence.
- [Quick Start](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Gate signatures and cases on a plain JavaScript file — npx nudojs check / test.
- [Troubleshooting](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/getting-started/troubleshooting): First-hour FAQ: any vs unknown, number | string unions, silent editors, nudo test vs vitest, entry-may-throw, removed verbs, signatures on success.

### How-to (guides)

- [nudo check](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/check): nudo check — L1 refinement gate + L2 entry throws on Abs; prints signatures; CI command.
- [nudo test](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/test): nudo test — per-case call-site ground truth on Abs; synthetic call@/entry@ cases print by default; declared @nudo:case assertions drive the exit code; --from, --freeze, --json, --abs.
- [Performance: budgets & the analysis cache](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/performance): Nudo analysis performance — budgets (forks, calls, call sites), truncation diagnostics and fixes, the .nudo/cache disk cache, and what CI should (not) restore.
- [nudo contract](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/contract): nudo contract — print / draft / emit / reverse TypeScript into sidecar contracts. The Day 1 product face beside nudo check.
- [CLI Usage](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/cli): Drive Nudo from the terminal — task-oriented workflows for the product verbs (check / test / contract / export / health / migrate).
- [Recipes](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/recipes): Task recipes — CI gate, gradual contracts, monorepo, export, agents.
- [Examples](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/examples): Practical Nudo examples — call-site observation, sidecar contracts, strings, loops, unions, env/mocks — with real check/test output.
- [Error faces: Nudo vs TypeScript](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/error-faces): Top Nudo error faces next to TypeScript — actual values, Preds, and a fix line. Runnable, CI-pinned samples.
- [Error catalog: Nudo vs tsc](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/errors-vs-typescript): Ten real error scenarios, one file — what tsc reports (or stays silent about), what Nudo reports (value + Pred), and the fix path. Runnable, CI-pinned.
- [Export: bridge to the ecosystem](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/export-ecosystem): Bridge Abs to the ecosystem with nudo export — .d.ts, zero-dependency guards, Zod dialect schemas, Standard Schema validators; a full walkthrough with verified examples, and where Nudo ends and schema libraries begin.
- [nudo health](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/health): nudo health — analysis errors and solidification drift in CI.
- [Dependency types](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/env-harvest): Where dependency types come from — fixed es/web/node envs, silent @types auto-fill, and when to mock.
- [Call-Site Discovery](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/callsite-discovery): Harvest real argument shapes from your tests and apps with --from, synthesize call@L cases from them, and freeze them as directives with test --freeze.
- [Migrating existing JS](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/migrating-js): Migrate an existing JavaScript package to Nudo: draft contracts from code, review, persist, then gate with check/health.
- [Migrating from TypeScript](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/migrating-from-typescript): Retire tsc with nudo migrate — status → strip → verify → retire. Coexistence is a migration tactic, not the end state.
- [Coexistence with TypeScript](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/coexistence): Short-lived dual gates while you migrate package by package — the exit is nudo migrate retire.
- [Case study: retire tsc](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/case-study-retire): Public retire-tsc case studies — checkout-demo, real packages ms and debug. One-way door, no dual-run endgame.
- [Versioning & Releases](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/versioning): How Nudo packages are versioned: 0.x vs 1.x SemVer, what counts as breaking, changeset workflow, and migration notes.
- [Competitive Landscape](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/competitive-landscape): Where Nudo sits against TypeScript, Flow, Hegel, schema libraries, and refinement types — the division of labor, not a feature checklist.
- [Nudo vs TypeScript](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/vs-typescript): Nudo vs TypeScript — where the replacement happens (DX and fact quality), how declaration and inference differ, and the scope bounds of “replace.”
- [AI-native DX](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/ai-native-dx): AI-native DX — why agents close red→green with less noise on Nudo than on TypeScript. Structured actions, honest unknown, and measurable evals.
- [Agent Integration Guide](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/agent-integration): Connect AI coding agents to Nudo's language server: LSP→MCP bridges, native LSP clients, agent commands (check/test/contract/hover/whatIf/…), and pull diagnostics.
- [LSP Client Matrix](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/lsp-clients): Capability matrix for Nudo's language server across VS Code, Zed, Neovim, Helix, and generic LSP clients — plus known gaps.
- [VS Code Extension](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/vscode): Install the nudo-vscode extension for hover types, completions, case-switching CodeLens, inlay hints, and diagnostics powered by Nudo's language server.
- [Zed Extension](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/zed): Install the Nudo language server in Zed: hover types, diagnostics, CodeLens case switching, inlay hints.
- [Vite Plugin](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/guides/vite-plugin): Analyze @nudo: type-inference directives during Vite builds with vite-plugin-nudo: configurable include/exclude globs, build warnings, and failOnError.

### Concepts

- [Abs — the type system](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/abs): Abs — how Nudo represents a variable close to runtime (shape × term × pred × conf): computable values with constraints that participate in algebra.
- [HOF relations](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/hof-relations): HOF relations — how Nudo derives the return shape of map(xs, f) style higher-order functions without a generics language (fnRels / entryShapes / hofSites), plus relationFn() for env authors.
- [Abstract Interpretation](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/abstract-interpretation): How Nudo computes runtime-adjacent variables in the source — abstract interpretation: executing code on Abs so intermediates carry values, shapes, and constraints.
- [Language Semantics](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/semantics): Learn the JavaScript semantics Nudo's evaluator models precisely today — string methods, for-of, break, Object.keys, recursion — and the constructs that still degrade to unknown.
- [Directives](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/directives): Syntax reference for all @nudo: directives — case, mock, pure, skip, sample, contract, throws, import, env, mock-module, as, replace — with constraints and examples.
- [Control Flow Narrowing](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/control-flow-narrowing): See how Nudo narrows types per call site — equality guards, discriminated object shapes, typeof, Array.isArray, switch, and literal truthiness — plus the current limits of unknown-condition branches, in, and ?./??.
- [Mocking External Dependencies](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/mocking): Mock external dependencies during evaluation — five @nudo:mock forms (arrow functions, stub helpers, builders, from-module), the single-line rule, and evaluator caveats.
- [Concept Layers](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/layers): How Nudo layers the goal of runtime-adjacent variables — Observation (Day 0), Contracts (Day 1), advanced Abs.
- [Limits & non-goals](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/concepts/limits): Limits and non-goals — what Nudo does not claim, call-site ceilings, evaluator gaps, and the TypeScript type-language boundary.

### Reference

- [Diagnostics glossary](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/reference/diagnostics): Stable Nudo diagnostic codes — meaning, minimal repro, Abs view, and fixes.
- [Glossary](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/glossary): Glossary — Abs (name and parts), conf grades, evaluator, fail-closed, any vs unknown, L1/L2, contracts, call sites.
- [Agents](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/reference/agents): Nudo for AI coding agents — product rules, Observation commands, machine-readable diagnostics, MCP/LSP pointers.
- [Configuration reference](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/reference/config): Every package.json#nudo key and NUDO_* environment variable — values, defaults, precedence, and where each is enforced.

### API

- [CLI Reference](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/cli-reference): Reference every nudo CLI command — check, test, contract, export, health, migrate — with arguments, options, output formats, and exit codes.
- [@nudojs/core](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/core): @nudojs/core API — the Abs type system (shape × term × pred × conf), constructors, assignability and formatting, operator semantics, template strings, mock helpers, and Environment.
- [@nudojs/parser](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/parser): @nudojs/parser API — parse() with TypeScript stripping, stripTypes, function/file/inline directive extraction, and directive type definitions.
- [@nudojs/service](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/service): @nudojs/service API — analyzeFile/analyzeFileAsync, call-record collection, module graph and dirty set, semantic tokens, d.ts/zod/guard generation, case emission.
- [@nudojs/harvester](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/harvester): @nudojs/harvester API — harvestDts and emitEnvModule: convert @types .d.ts declarations into Nudo env definitions with Abs constructors.
- [@nudojs/lsp](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/lsp): @nudojs/lsp API — the language server over @nudojs/service: validation pipeline and caches, symbols, semantic tokens, agent tools, capabilities.
- [Agent API](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/api/agent): Agent API — nudo.* commands: check (Abs gate), test, contract, hover, whatIf, suggestCase, trace, selectCase, getActiveCases.

### Design & meta

- [Design Document](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/design/design-doc): Nudo by design: Abs = shape × term × pred × conf as the single type system, extensional projection for display, directives, and what executing code computes that a separate type language cannot.
- [Design notes (repo)](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/design/notes): Index of the repository design notes — architecture truth sources (Abs, CLI semantics, evaluation, interface derivation, caches, limitations) behind the product pages.
- [Contributing](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/contributing): Set up the Nudo monorepo and contribute — project structure, development workflow, operator semantics, directives, and docs.
- [Releases](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/releases): Current per-package release notes — generated from changesets CHANGELOGs; breaking changes carry migration notes.
- [Full release history](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/docs/releases-history): Full per-package release history — generated from changesets CHANGELOGs; large page, excluded from search.

### Blog (short slugs)

- [Day 0 — observe JavaScript without rewriting it](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/day0-observe): Welcome back to JavaScript. Nudo does not ask you to rewrite a JS package in another language surface before you can see types or gate obligations.
- [Contracts are JS — Day 1 with sidecar *.nudo.js](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/day1-contracts): Nudo’s contract product is not a second type language. Contracts are ordinary JavaScript modules: sidecar .nudo.js files that auto-bind to same-name exports, or in-source @nudo:contract.
- [Nudo vs TypeScript — when a JS-first gate is the right tool](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/vs-typescript): Honest positioning: Nudo is built to replace TypeScript as the day-to-day type gate for JavaScript-first codebases — not to reimplement the TypeScript compiler.
- [The 22-file smear: how call-site attribution almost shipped fake precision](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/attribution-gate): Call-site discovery (nudo test lib/ --from test/) harvests real argument shapes from usage sites and synthesizes call@L… cases from them. The promise is precision for free: no directives, no annotations, just the arguments your code is actually called with.
- [Nudo for coding agents — agents.md, agent integration, stable diagnostics](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/agents-docs): Nudo’s observation output is already structured. Agents need a stable product contract too.
- [We retired tsc on our JavaScript packages — and the gate got sharper](https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/blog/retiring-typescript-in-practice): Most teams keep tsc --noEmit around not because they enjoy writing annotations, but because there was no other CI gate to reach for. Nudo's answer is not "write a second type language". It is three commitments:## Per-page markdown (same route + `.md`)

Chinese pages live under the `/zh-Hans/` prefix — same path after the locale segment:

- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/intro

- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/blog/day0-observe

Raw markdown for the mirror follows the same pattern: append `.md` under `/zh-Hans/…` (e.g. `https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/intro.md`). Source files live in `packages/website/i18n/zh-Hans/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/` and `…-blog/`.
